title: How to average values between two dates
task: The mean of values within a date range — average order value in a period, average daily total for a month.

excel.note: Same pattern as SUMIFS but averages. Returns #DIV/0! if no rows fall in the range.

explanation: AVERAGEIFS works exactly like SUMIFS with two date bounds, but takes the mean of the qualifying rows instead of the total: the two rows inside the July 24-31, 2026 window are 100 and 40, averaging 70 (the out-of-range row is skipped). Reference the bounds from cells (D1/D2) with the ">="&D1 concatenation to make the period adjustable. One thing to guard: if no rows fall in the range, AVERAGEIFS returns #DIV/0! — wrap in IFERROR(...,0) or IFERROR(...,"-") if an empty period is possible. Add more range/criteria pairs (region, product) to average a slice within the period.
